content:
— 200 Returned if Tenable MSSP Portal successfully deletes the specified logo.
404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Portal cannot find the specified logo.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
A brief message about the object that could not be found.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
